resources.string: Keep dated paths visible when you switch off the live object.
Uncheck each date separately in Objects, Key Heights, Key Events or Personal Moments.
Active dates stay grouped under their object in the catalogue, even when the live row is unchecked.
Live and dated selections are saved separately across app restarts.
Selected points and their antipodes remain available on active dated paths.
Photos, panoramas and Location exports with celestial objects can include active dated paths.
